senses.gloss: m. (חסף; cmp. כסופא) shame; (cmp. b. h. בּשֶׁת) idol.
units: Y. Ned. I, 37ᵃ top (in answer to the question, ‘Does not ḥeres mean a sherd?’) לשון אומות … קריין לח׳ כספא (ḥeres may be used as a substitute for חֵרֶם) for it is a gentile dialect, the Nabatæans say ḥispa for kispa (כסופא) (which means shame or idol); Y. Naz. I, beg. 51ᵃ (corr. acc.); v.
